scripts.prompt:generate: bun -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const {openuiChatPromptOptions}=require("@openuidev/react-ui"); const {myLibrary}=require("./openui-frontend/src/lib/my-library.tsx"); const prompt=myLibrary.prompt({...openuiChatPromptOptions, componentGroups: {...openuiChatPromptOptions.componentGroups, "Custom Cards": [myLibrary.components.WeatherCard, myLibrary.components.StockCard, myLibrary.components.TaskCard, myLibrary.components.DocPreviewCard]}, additionalRules: [...(openuiChatPromptOptions.additionalRules || []), "When the user asks for weather, call the Weather tool and render the result using WeatherCard.", "When the user asks for stock quotes, call StockQuoteTool and render using StockCard.", "When the user asks to manage or view tasks, call TaskManagerTool and render using TaskCard or list of TaskCards.", "When the user asks about documentation, specs, pricing, or product features, call SearchDocsTool to retrieve accurate information and render using DocPreviewCard.", "When the user asks about recent events, live web facts, or news, call WebSearchTool. To extract full content from a specific URL, call WebScrapeTool."]}); fs.writeFileSync("config/system_prompt_openui.txt", prompt); console.log("Generated config/system_prompt_openui.txt with all tools");'
